answer: An attacker must acquire and stake many distinct bonds, paying real capital plus compute, and any slashable offense burns the bond. To resist sybils, mandate each agent to stake a unique hardware-attested identity bond and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to its public key; duplicate keys collapse to one identity. Newcomers may wander in freely, but sustained influence requires accumulating reputation like fruit in an orchard, while anonymous throwaway accounts sink like stones in the ocean of low-trust peers. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
